dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, did you find that famous khao soi restaurant in Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈfaɪnd ðæt ˈfeɪməs ˈkaʊ ˈsɔɪ ˈrɛstərɑːnt ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, finally! But it's a long story.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈfaɪnəli! bʌt ɪts ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈstɔːri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At first, we couldn't find it. The map on my phone showed the wrong street.
dialogue.reading: ət ˈfɜːrst, wiː ˈkʊdənt ˈfaɪnd ɪt. ðə ˈmæp ɑːn maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈʃoʊd ðə ˈrɔːŋ ˈstriːt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh dear. What did you do?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈdɪr. ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We walked for an hour in the heat. At last, an old man showed us the way.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwɔːkt fər ən ˈaʊər ɪn ðə ˈhiːt. ət ˈlæst, ən ˈoʊld ˈmæn ˈʃoʊd ʌs ðə ˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: At last! Was the food worth it?
dialogue.reading: ət ˈlæst! wʌz ðə ˈfuːd ˈwɜːrθ ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, it turned out that the restaurant was closed on Mondays!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ɪt ˈtɜːrnd ˈaʊt ðæt ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt wʌz ˈkloʊzd ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh no! So you didn't eat there after all?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! soʊ juː ˈdɪdənt ˈiːt ðɛr ˈæftər ˈɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not that day. We ate at a small stall next door, and it turned out to be delicious!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ðæt ˈdeɪ. wiː ˈeɪt ət ə ˈsmɔːl ˈstɔːl ˈnɛkst ˈdɔːr, ənd ɪt ˈtɜːrnd ˈaʊt tə bi dɪˈlɪʃəs!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So the trip wasn't a waste of time after all.
dialogue.reading: soʊ ðə ˈtrɪp ˈwʌzənt ə ˈweɪst əv ˈtaɪm ˈæftər ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. And on Tuesday, we finally ate at the famous restaurant. It was good, but the stall was better!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ənd ɑːn ˈtuːzdeɪ, wiː ˈfaɪnəli ˈeɪt ət ðə ˈfeɪməs ˈrɛstərɑːnt. ɪt wʌz ˈɡʊd, bʌt ðə ˈstɔːl wʌz ˈbɛtər!
